ReviewSubmitted.description: A review submitted on a pull request; pending reviews are skipped.

association.description:
GitHub's `author_association` of the author, such as `OWNER`, `COLLABORATOR` or `NONE`.
Feedback from anyone but the owner, a member or a collaborator reaches no task.

author.description: The GitHub login who opened the pull request; absent when GitHub does not say.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request merges into.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

body.description: The review's summary Markdown, as written; empty when the reviewer wrote none.

bot.description:
True when a bot reviewed; absent otherwise. A trigger starts a task from a bot's review
only when its `commenter` filter names the bot.

commit.description: The commit the review was written on, which `head_sha` passes once a commit is pushed after it.

delivery.description:
The `X-GitHub-Delivery` of the webhook delivery that reported it; absent when a poll did.
GitHub does not sign it.

head_branch.description: The head branch; null when GitHub no longer returns the pull request.

head_repo.description:
The head branch's repository, `owner/name`, which differs from `repo` for a fork; absent
when the event does not say, as for a check run or a deleted fork.

head_sha.description: The head commit; for a check, the commit it ran on.

open.description:
Whether the pull request was open when the intake read it; a done task reopens only
for feedback on an open one.

own.description:
Whether the login `gh api user` names wrote it, the login a worker posts as; absent while
`gh` cannot say. A comment another login wrote wakes its task even when it was written
during the agent's turn.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

url.description: The pull request's page; the review's for a review, the check run's for a check.

description: A review submitted on a pull request; pending reviews are skipped.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: github.pull_request_review.submitted
